title: Alberta Cancer Exercise Dose in Colorectal Cancer
official: Alberta Cancer Exercise Dose in Colorectal Cancer
summary: The purpose of this pilot randomized, wait-list controlled study is to evaluate the effects of exercise dose in terms of frequency (1 vs. 2 days per week) in individuals on systemic treatment for colorectal cancer. The impact on the individual (physical function, quality of life, fatigue and other patient reported outcomes) as well as on health care utilization (cost to deliver, cost to individuals, savings and impact to the health care system) will be evaluated. In addition, assessments of immunological markers to better understand the biological impact of exercise dose on immunological markers will be explored.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults (≥18)
* Have a primary biopsy-proven diagnosis of colon or rectal adenocarcinoma and undergoing adjuvant systemic treatment
* Cleared for exercise (PAR-Q+)
* Able to attend scheduled sessions
* Able to provide informed written consent in English.
* Not meeting current aerobic exercise guidelines (i.e. performing \< 90 minutes of moderate to vigorous physical activity per week in the past month)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Participants who have completed adjuvant treatment for CRC
* Unstable cardiopulmonary disease
* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Active infection
* Recent autoimmune flare
* Contraindication to needles/venipuncture
* Grade 2 or higher diarrhea secondary to systemic treatment
